results.failure: An unref'd restart timer let the supervisor exit.
results.consequence: The entry point owns a keep-alive while library timers remain non-blocking.

results.failure: A crash before handshake could cancel a required restart.
results.consequence: Handshake death and steady-state death use distinct transitions.

results.failure: Readiness waiting could outlive a dead child.
results.consequence: Child exit cancels readiness waiting.

results.failure: Runtime-discovered capabilities could widen permission surface.
results.consequence: Capabilities are declared and allow-listed before launch.

results.failure: Weighted pressure made restart unreachable.
results.consequence: Severe signals and restart authority are modeled separately.

results.failure: Epoch-zero cooldown and reads mutated health state.
results.consequence: Reads are side-effect free and cooldown handles zero timestamps.

results.failure: Cordis parser and service mismatches broke adaptation.
results.consequence: Controlled providers and degraded browser halves are reported honestly.

results.failure: Broad route reservation and handler errors returned HTTP 200.
results.consequence: Exact route ownership and error-status propagation are required.

results.failure: Activation failure was overwritten, refusal counted twice, and native main ignored.
results.consequence: One terminal result per stage and tested native entry resolution.

results.failure: Installer reported Plugin Market failure after materialization succeeded.
results.consequence: Materialized package and profile state outrank stale transient output.

results.failure: Project tests wrote to C drive and left a host process.
results.consequence: Explicit D roots plus post-test process and storage gates.

results.failure: Phase C reached only 1.189x against a 1.2x threshold.
results.consequence: Identical validations are batched; the threshold and workload remain unchanged.

results.failure: A soak report passed while its top summary exit code was 2.
results.consequence: Immutable run directories and consistency checking fail closed.

results.failure: Junction-based Plugin Market isolation returned zero rows.
results.consequence: The rejected experiment is retained and canonical identity is implemented directly.

results.failure: A CDP target existed before documentElement.
results.consequence: UI acceptance waits for a renderer document.

results.failure: Qualification depended on prebuilt D:\test-DSH samples.
results.consequence: Pinned upstream fixtures are freshly installed and built per run.

results.failure: Stale companion PID masked a live launch.
results.consequence: Prefer live launch during PID hand-off.

results.failure: Windows TEMP short-name alias contradicted a literal path assertion.
results.consequence: Canonical ancestor plus case-preserved missing tail.

results.failure: Crash ledger preceded the relaunched application's PID evidence.
results.consequence: Wait for distinct live PID within unchanged budget.

results.failure: Failed continuity verification still executed recovery and erased intent.
results.consequence: Refuse execution and retain durable intent on failed verification.

results.failure: Direct instance tests inherited caller TEMP and the C-drive audit missed dshns names.
results.consequence: Use repository-volume test roots and include instance names in the real audit; preserve historical failed audit and moved scratch.

results.failure: Stationary pointermove events turned orb clicks into drags and suppressed panel expansion.
results.consequence: Measure from pointer-down coordinates and apply a bounded drag threshold; verify real click, expansion and detail feedback.

results.failure: A generic billing timezone label implied that a browser-local scheduling input used Asia/Shanghai.
results.consequence: Identify local input time separately from model billing timezone in both task forms without changing scheduling semantics.

results.failure: Source junctions concealed required contract/status files omitted from built-in plugin packages; fresh installation passed smoke but failed real launch.
results.consequence: Include runtime files in package allowlists and test actual packed/extracted packages without source access during installer smoke and full qualification.

results.failure: A concurrent qualification UI occupied3099, invalidating a unit test's free-port precondition and its nested storage test.
results.consequence: Reserve machine-test ports and serialize qualification UI; preserve the failed full run rather than substituting a focused rerun.

results.failure: Native-picker acceptance used broad window titles and delayed global keystrokes, sending a fixture path into another qualification conversation.
results.consequence: Remove global input; require targeted native interaction and actual installation evidence, with no fallback success certificate.

results.failure: Real native input invalidated a later visible-dock precondition; descendant control blur was miscounted as renderer focus loss.
results.consequence: Restore and assert the actual surface precondition, scope focus observations to their claimed target, preserve failed full qualification.

results.failure: Repeated Electron observation created new adapters and native Debugger listeners were not removed on detach.
results.consequence: Own one current-view adapter, remove native listeners on release, invalidate bootstrap on connection loss; never raise the listener limit to hide growth.

results.failure: Paper claim IDs differed between Markdown and JSON; conceptual paths and generic artifact labels misattributed measurements to an untested commit.
results.consequence: Validate canonical claim identities, real source/test paths and hash-bound historical run/SHA/child verdicts; preserve failed UI evidence and separate code SHA from evidence commit.
